title: Life Rated PG: Pathetic in General

beats.story: I'm unwinding from my second full Cliff-free day of work by not quite enjoying a burned package of instant popcorn while checking Reddit to figure out who is the asshole, when there's a knock at my door. I run to open it in case it's my mom ready to make another scene, but Miley's eager face is waiting on the other side. Her gaze weaves past me, jumping from the cluttered coffee table to the erratic shoe party below it. "So, this is your place. I've never seen past your shoe rack every time I try and peep." My hand braces to slam the door -- a purely robotic instinct -- but I instead give her a deadpan stare. "What can I help you with?" Her lips curl upward at the opening. "Glad you asked. I've always thought of you as someone who could think objectively about unjust rules and would fight for those harmed by them if you could." I let out a hefty sigh.
beats.story_cn: 我正以边嚼焦糊爆米花边刷Reddit的方式，试图熬过不被克里夫搅扰的第二个工作日——此刻正琢磨网上哪个混账惹了众怒，门铃骤然响起。我冲去开门，生怕又是母亲大人来上演全武行，但门后却撞见米莉那张写满期待的脸。她的目光越过我肩头，在凌乱的茶几和下方如叛军散落的鞋堆间跳转："原来这就是你家。每次偷窥都被鞋架挡着，今天可算见着全貌了。"我抬手欲摔门——这纯粹是机械性防御——最终却只对她投去死水般的眼神："有何贵干？"她嘴角咧出得逞的弧度："就等你问这句。我一直觉得你是那种能理性审视不公规则的人，若有机会定会为受害者挺身而出。"我重重叹出肺里残存的空气。

beats.story: "Miley, please just tell me what I can do for you. I've had a rough week . . ." She rocks on her toes, her hands clasped behind her back. "You know what's the perfect cure for rough weeks? Taking your favorite neighbor to the movies." She splays out her hands. I back a step away from the threshold. "There's no way." Miley shakes her head.
beats.story_cn: "米莉，直接告诉我能帮什么忙吧。这周我过得够呛……"她踮着脚尖轻晃，双手背在身后绞缠："知道治愈糟糕周的最佳疗法吗？带上你最可爱的邻居去看电影。"她摊开双手，我向门内退避半步："没门儿。"米莉摇起头。

beats.story: "Please -- I'm begging you. I need to see this movie. I'm the only one in my whole school who hasn't seen it! It's at seven o'clock, so you'll be home at a normal hour, I promise!" I grab for my wallet, splayed on the shoe rack where I dropped it when I got home. "How much? I can loan you the money." Miley stiffens, her wide puppy eyes turning to maximum strength. "No, it's not that. I have the money.
beats.story_cn: "求你了——我跪求。必须看这场电影。全校就我没看过！七点开场，保证散场后你还能正常作息！"我扑向鞋架上归家时随手丢的钱包："要多少？我可以借你。"米莉身体僵直，圆睁的泪眼瞬间切换至终极模式："不不，我有钱。"

beats.story: But it's rated R, so I need someone old to escort me in." I scoff. "So you basically need me to take a minor into a movie illegally?" She throws her head back. "It's a stupid law. You know I've seen worse around here than anything they could put in some slasher film." She's got a point. Just behind her, there's a punch hole in the drywall. Both Miley and I were there when the guy down the hall got pissed because his Wi-Fi broke and he yelled at everyone in the world before taking it out on the communal wall. Its twin hole is in the lobby, from when the couple upstairs broke up, and we all had to hear about the deficiencies of their sex life while personal items were thrown down the stairwell. Miley presses her hands against the archway to prevent me from closing the door.
beats.story_cn: “可这是R级片，我需要成年人陪才能进场。”我嗤笑一声，“所以你本质上想让我带未成年人非法看电影？”她仰头翻了个白眼，“愚蠢的法律。你知道我在这儿见识过的事，比那些砍杀电影里的画面狠多了。”这话不假。就在她身后的石膏板墙上，有个拳头大的洞。走廊那头的家伙因Wi-Fi故障暴跳如雷，对着全世界吼完一通后，拿公共墙面当了出气筒——那时我和米莉都在场。而它墙上的孪生伤疤在大厅里，源于楼上那对情侣分手时闹剧：我们被迫听着他们数落彼此的性生活缺陷，私人衣物像雪花般抛下楼梯间。米莉用双手抵住拱门，不让我关门。

beats.story: "Pleaaaase? My mom would do it if she wasn't too busy to take me." I turn my head and look back at my drab apartment. My blinds aren't up to the job of hiding the sun that's creeping through. And maybe I could use the company. Things feel so empty since returning to my life before Cliff. I sigh, and it's like my resolve crumbles in front of her eyes. "Fine." "Yay! I knew you'd do the right thing." She grabs my arms, but I keep them planted in my hoodie pocket.
beats.story_cn: “拜——托？我妈要不是太忙，肯定带我去了。”我转过头，望向身后那间单调的公寓。百叶帘未能挡住悄然渗入的阳光。也许我正需要点陪伴。自从回到克里夫之前的生活后，一切显得如此空洞。我叹了口气，仿佛决心在她眼前碎裂。“好吧。”“耶！就知道你会做对的事。”她抓住我的胳膊，我却仍把手深插在连帽衫口袋里。

beats.story: "Meet me out front in ten minutes," I huff. I throw on a dressier hoodie and jeans for the occasion. Miley's hopping from foot to foot out front while she waits. We walk to the theater together. Outside the front entrance, two middle- aged men are smoking and muttering to each other. They stop mid- conversation as Miley and I walk by. I clench my fists, just waiting for them to make some creepy comment. The potential for random shit like this is what's wrong with the world.
beats.story_cn: “十分钟后门口见。”我气呼呼地说。为这趟出行换了件挺括的连帽衫和牛仔裤。米莉在门口等候时正单脚交替蹦跳着。我们一同走向影院。正门外，两个中年男人边抽烟边嘀咕。我和米莉经过时，他们的谈话戛然而止。我握紧双拳，只等他们冒出猥琐言论。正是这种随机降临的破事，构成了世界的病症。

beats.story: We pass without incident, and inside security isn't exactly airport standard; they don't even look at us. Once we're seated in creaky felt chairs with vintage farts stored in their cushions, the smell of butter drizzle becoming part of us, I say, "Can I sneak out now that the mission is accomplished?" Miley, who's busy taking a selfie of herself at the theater, tilts her phone down. "No way. You can't leave me alone with a bunch of adults." She leans closer and whispers, "What if a child predator comes?" Then she silently points at what I'm sure is probably a very nice man with a silky scarf sitting in front of us. "Fine, but I don't like horror movies." The whites of her eyes widen and glint in the overhead lighting. "Yeah, I don't like them either." "Why the hell do we have to see it then? This was meant as a whole thing to let you actually have some joy." "It is bringing me joy. I need to see this movie.
beats.story_cn: 我们顺利通过，安检标准远不及机场——他们甚至没正眼瞧我们。坐进吱呀作响的绒布椅（坐垫里封存着上个世纪的屁味），黄油淋酱的气味渐渐渗入肌肤，我压低声音：“任务完成，能溜了吗？”米莉正忙着在剧院里自拍，闻言把手机往下倾斜。“想得美，别想把我一个人丢给这群大人。”她凑近些，耳语道：“万一遇到恋童癖怎么办？”接着她无声地指向前排那个围着丝质围巾、看起来明明很友善的男人。[4] 有策略地主动出击，为办公室聚会寻找体面的脱身之道。

beats.story: My two almost friends, Sandra and Sarah, who are coming for a slumber party, have started leaving me out for not seeing it. And why? Because Sandra's creepy brother took them." Miley squeezes her hands together on her lap. So much of the girl I once was bounces in her seat. I lean in, voice softer. "Miley, I haven't forgotten what it's like to be your age -- how hard it is." She shrugs. "Good, then you understand why." "Yeah, but . .
beats.story_cn: “我那两个准朋友，桑德拉和莎拉，本来要来参加睡衣派对的，就因为没看那部电影开始孤立我。凭什么？就因为桑德拉那个变态哥哥带她们去了。”米莉双手紧握在膝头。我曾经熟悉的那个女孩在她身上隐隐浮现。我倾身向前，放软声音：“米莉，我没忘记在你这个年纪是什么感觉——有多难熬。”她耸耸肩：“那就好，这样你就明白为什么了。”“是啊，但是……”

beats.story: "Well, to me your crochet is charming, and my actual point is that anyone would be lucky to have a thoughtful friend like you. Take it from me; it's better to be a little picky and hold out for real friends, 'cause the fake friends can crush you." "But who wants to be that picky?" She leans in conspiringly, the tang of soda on her breath, in the orange on her lips. "Now that you're old, aren't you, like, allowed to do whatever you want without asking? But you never do. It's like you've grounded yourself." I stiffen. She keeps going. "You don't even drive with that friend from your work anymore. Picky again?" I fully turn to stone.
beats.story_cn: “可在我看来，你的钩针活儿很可爱。我真正想说的是，谁都幸运能有你这样体贴的朋友。听我一句劝；挑剔一点、等来真正的朋友，总比交些假朋友强，假朋友能把你伤透。”“可谁愿意那么挑剔呢？”她倾身过来，像分享秘密，呼吸间带着汽水的酸甜，嘴唇上还沾着橘子的橙红。“你现在都这把年纪了，不是爱干嘛就干嘛，不用问人吗？可你从不。好像自己给自己禁足了似的。”我身体一僵。她还在说：“你连单位那个朋友都不一起开车了。又是因为挑剔？”我彻底石化了。

Our gazes turn back to Cliff, who has taken a seat a few rows ahead. He's chatting easily, picking pieces of popcorn from the bag sitting in the woman's lap. He's so casual and happy looking. The attractive brunette leans close and whispers in his ear.
beats.story_cn: “我们正说他呢！那是你男朋友吗？”“不是！”我几乎喊出来，捏得她胳膊有点用力过猛。“小声点。别让他看见我。”我们的目光重新聚焦在克里夫身上，他坐在前几排。他谈笑风生，从搁在女伴膝上的袋子里拣爆米花吃。那副松弛自在的模样显得如此快乐。迷人的棕发女郎凑近，在他耳边低语。

I wake from the nightmare as the lights finally come on and the theater begins to empty. I have no idea what we just saw. I spent the entire time watching the dark outline of Cliff's head, analyzing every inch of space between him and that woman. They start to stand up, and so does Miley, but I pull her back down.
beats.story_cn: 如今一切尘埃落定。他向前走了。这没什么不好。米莉投来一个意味深长的眼神，洞悉得过了头。“当然啦，乔琳。”灯亮起时我从噩梦中惊醒，剧院开始散场。我完全不知道我们刚看了什么。整场我都在凝视着克利夫头部的黑色剪影，计较着他与那个女人之间每一寸距离。他们起身时米莉也要站起来，但我把她拉回了座位。

beats.story: "Let's give them a buffer." She nods, and we let them pass. We wait a full five minutes before she finally tugs on my sleeve and says, "Come on, let's go! I have to pee!" I'm waiting outside the bathroom door for her when the men's room door opens and, for fuck's sake, it's Cliff who comes out. He glances up and physically stops in his tracks, his jaw dropping. He looks as horrified to see me here as I am to see him. "Jolene!" There's a hesitation to the way he says my name, like he can't quite believe this is happening. I take a step backward without meaning to. Then that brunette appears and sidles next to him, all cozy, and smiles at me.
beats.story_cn: “让他们先走吧。”她点头，我们让出通道。足足等了五分钟，她终于拽了拽我袖子说：“快走！我要憋不住了！”我在女厕门外等她时，男厕门开了——见鬼的，竟然是克利夫。他抬眼瞥见我，整个人僵在原地，下巴都快掉下来。他看到我时惊恐的神色，跟我见到他时一模一样。“乔琳！”他喊我名字时带着迟疑，仿佛不敢相信眼前发生的一切。我不由自主后退半步。这时那个深色卷发的女人贴了上来，亲昵地挨着他，对我展露微笑。

Silvia, this is my colleague Jolene." Silvia's kind smile makes me want to crush into myself. She's pretty, really pretty, with the kind of gentle curls that look effortless but probably took her three hours to perfect. And she likes Warhammer. Miley pops out of the bathroom, and her eyes instantly go wide as she takes in the drama.
beats.story_cn: 克利夫整个人依然紧绷。他不敢直视我。“这是西尔维娅，”他笨拙地比划着介绍，“我们经常一起打《战锤》。西尔维娅，这位是我的同事乔琳。”西尔维娅温和的笑容让我想把自己缩成一团。她很漂亮，非常漂亮，那头看似随意的卷发大概花了三小时打理。而且她竟然也玩战锤。米莉从洗手间跳出来，目睹这番场面时眼睛瞪得滚圆。

beats.story: She runs up to me and grabs my arm. "This is Miley," I say, looking anywhere but Cliff. Silvia's grin turns even warmer. "We were just about to get some food. Would you and your young friend like to grab a ton of tacos from next door with us?" Cliff's head starts to shake, but it's Miley who pipes in. "You mean me and Jolene? We're not really friends. She just snuck me into an R-rated movie.
beats.story_cn: 她冲过来抓住我的胳膊。“这是麦莉。”我开口道，目光拼命躲闪着克利夫。西尔维亚的笑容愈发灿烂。“我们正准备去吃饭。要不要和你的小朋友一起去隔壁吃一堆玉米卷？”克利夫已经开始摇头，麦莉却抢先开口：“你是说我和乔琳？我们根本不算朋友。她只是偷偷带我混进R级电影。”

beats.story: I'm only twelve." "Oh?" Silvia's smile falters. My insides turn to stone, yet Miley doesn't stop. "But we can't go for food with you. My mom doesn't even know I'm out, so I should get home." "Miley," I whisper, "could you kindly shut up?" I smile through my teeth. And why doesn't this theater have any fainting chairs? My eyes dart to the exit as I back away, legs as heavy as bags of sand. "I'm sorry, but Miley's right. We've got to head back." Cliff doesn't say anything, just looks at the carpet.
beats.story_cn: “我才十二岁。”“哦？”西尔维亚的笑容僵住了。我胃里像灌了石头，麦莉却还在说。“但我们不能跟您去吃饭。我妈都不知道我溜出来了，我得回家。”“麦莉，”我压低声音，“麻烦你闭嘴好吗？”我咬着牙挤出微笑。这影院怎么就没配个昏厥椅？我一边后退一边用眼找出口，双腿沉得像灌了沙。“抱歉，但麦莉说得对。我们得回去了。”克利夫一言不发，只盯着地毯。

beats.story: I wave and pull Miley along. I'm walking really fast, and her breath hitches as she keeps pace. Once we're clear of the theater, Miley finally yells, "Jolene, what the hell?" "I never should have brought you here. Why did you say that?" I spit my words out. "I'm so embarrassed. Look at me, just hanging out with you while he's on a date." Her face crumbles. Shit. "No, Miley.
beats.story_cn: 我挥挥手，拉上麦莉快步就走。我步子迈得飞快，她气喘吁吁地跟上。一离开剧场，麦莉终于喊道：“乔琳，你到底搞什么鬼？”“我根本不该带你来。你为什么要说那种话？”我语带嫌恶。“我丢死人了。看看我，在他约会的时候，就只配和你闲晃。”她的脸垮了下来。糟了。“不，麦莉。”
